content/schema/effects.json._comment: The one list of triggers, selectors, conditions, effects and mechanic parameters. The engine (EffectSchema, MechanicRegistry), the content checker (tools/checks/check_units.py) and the docs test all read this file. Kinds: number doubles on golden; threshold keeps its value (rulebook 7.3.5).

keywords.Acorn: Play for gold: Acorn {acorn}, Stash {stash}, Great Hoard {great_hoard}. Three make the next size.
keywords.Belly: Holds this many units, safe inside. When this dies, they come out.
keywords.Bitter: When an enemy attacks this, it first loses this much Attack, down to 1.
keywords.Borrowed: Fights for the other side for one attack, then goes home.
keywords.Bristle: An enemy that hits this in an attack takes this much back.
keywords.Cleave: Attacks also hit the units beside the target.
keywords.Damage Reduction: Takes this much less damage from each hit.
keywords.Egg: Holds a Nest while its Bird is flying south: half its stats, no text.
keywords.Fly South: Sells for no gold: it flies off and returns in 2 turns.
keywords.Hex: Start of Combat: whoever stands across has this much less Attack.
keywords.Mire: Start of Combat: the enemy across must attack this while this lives. This waits for it, once.
keywords.Mired: Must attack the unit that mired it.
keywords.Nest: While its Bird is away, an Egg with half its stats fights here, unless a unit stands on it.
keywords.Nightshade: When attacked, this first loses half its Health.
keywords.Pack: When a unit beside this attacks, this joins in, using up its own attack.
keywords.Pass: Pass X: your last unit, other than this, gains X
keywords.Pin: An enemy this hurts skips its next attack.
keywords.Pounce: After a unit next to this has its quarry hit, this attacks it too. Once a cycle.
keywords.Quarry: The enemy across becomes its quarry. This attacks it whenever it can.
keywords.Rainbow: A unit played into an empty slot paints it, until that unit moves or leaves.
keywords.Ring: Ring a slot: whoever stands there gets the bonus, up to +4/+4.
keywords.Shield: Prevents the first damage this would take each fight.
keywords.Shy: Only a spell aimed at this buffs it. Then it leaves: get 2 gold next turn.
keywords.Snap: Attacks the Mired enemy with the most Attack.
keywords.Spill: If a summon from this has no room, get an Acorn instead.
keywords.Stalled: Skips its next attack, then loses Stalled.
keywords.Swoop: Attacks the enemy back row while anyone is in it.

text_rules.pattern: (?i),?\s*(?:once|twice|\d+ times|(?:one|two|three|four) times) (?:a (?:turn|fight)|per enemy|in all|every other turn)
(?i)After your first unit buy each turn:
(?i)Your first Refresh each turn is free
(?i),?\s*up to (?!\d+ turns\b)(?:your tier(?: \+ \d+)?|[+-]?\d+(?:/[+-]?\d+)?(?: (?:gold(?: a turn)?|Takes|for that tribe))?)
